rule_or_pattern: Drop lines whose label is too short or too long for the crop: C:cpp_vs_book_out (label chars per crop width outside the book range) or C:len_vs_book_high, and crops taller than ~1.4x the page's median line height (two print lines in one box). Also fix Latin homoglyphs inside Greek all-caps words (e.g. 'ENOIKIA VIDEO' -> 'ΕΝΟΙΚΙΑ VIDEO').
notes: The random lines (1-20) of this typewritten 1986 parliament record read correctly. However, a clear set of anomalous lines has a crop that does not match its label. The label is a short fragment of a different line or of a neighbouring line: 22 '΄Όλα τα Κέντρα' under a full line, 28 'για τη συντα-' under 'Τσίτη είναι η ερώτηση...', 30 'όη Σεπτεμβρίου', 38 and 40 truncated. In other cases the crop spans two print lines (26, 35) or the label adds words not in the crop (23 '...έχει λάβει τα'). The page image shows overlapping boxes where Google merged pieces from different positions. Line 24 writes the Greek 'ΕΝΟΙΚΙΑ' in Latin homoglyphs.
